integrity.computational_scope: 21 exhaustive small-field convolution-energy comparisons and 74 radius-family character-sum checks; computation is corroboration, not infinite proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact Gauss-level counts, orthogonal and hyperbolic decompositions, quadratic character identities and a finite-field character-sum interchange.

scientific_limitations: Distinct nonzero radii and nondegenerate quadratic form in even dimension over odd finite fields.
The fourth Fourier moment is for the unweighted indicator; no sharp arbitrary-coefficient extension norm or radius-by-radius optimizer is claimed.
At singular quartic ratios the indicated trace correction is not represented as the Frobenius trace of a smooth elliptic curve.
Searches do not exclude an unindexed earlier general multi-shell theorem implying the trace-average identity.
title: Exact two-shell Fourier energy and a three-valued elliptic-trace cancellation
